title: Kvrobi's Legends of Chima
description: Lego Legends of Chima mod, in which I try to bring Chima into minecraft
body:
This mod attempts to bring the lego show Legend's of Chima to minecraft!

You need to add Geckolib 4.8.4 (I tested it with that version), found here on Modrinth: https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib/versions



It currently main features choosing your tribe,  with custom models for each tribe, some of the weapons of the Lion Tribe, Chi (not generated, only creative menu) and a chi energy system, so you can activate your weapons and armor, to make them stronger!

I made the models using blockbench
I made the textures too

I have a lot of things planned for the mod!

You can join the discord here: https://discord.gg/Mb9JCurdd5
